docs.title: Setting Up AKMenu-Next
docs.text:
Info

AKMenu-Next is a frontend for nds-bootstrap & Pico-Loader based on a fork of akmenu4 for running Nintendo DS Software & Homebrew. It supports cheats along with support for Acekard themes. For controls such as soft-reset and quitting games, please see nds-bootstrap controls

docs.title: Setup Guide:
docs.text:
FlashcartsDSpicoNintendo DSiNintendo 3DSUpdating

Note

This requires a modded Nintendo DSi system. If your Nintendo DSi is not modded, please follow dsi.cfw.guide to install it.

Note

This requires a modded Nintendo 3DS system. If your Nintendo 3DS is not modded, please follow 3ds.hacks.guide to install it. This guide is also applicable to the Nintendo 2DS models but will be referenced as a 3DS in the steps below.

Info

AKMenu-Next, nds-bootstrap and Pico-Loader must be updated seperately of each other. If you wish to check for the latest version of AKMenu-Next, nds-bootstrap and Pico-Loader, you can view the latest versions & changelog from the Github releases linked here: AKMenu-Next Releases - nds-bootstrap Releases - Pico-Loader Releases

Info

Need help or want to discuss AKMenu-Next? Check out the AKMenu-Next GBATemp Thread

docs.title: Installing AKMenu-Next Flashcart Edition
docs.text:
1. Download the latest release of AKMenu-Next Flashcart Edition.

  2. Extract the downloaded akmenu-next-flashcart.zip file with 7-Zip.

  3. From within the AKMenu-Next files, copy the following files/folders to your SD card root:

    • _nds folder
    • _pico folder
    • BOOT.NDS

Soft-Reset Not Supported for Pico-Loader

Note that Pico-Loader inside AKMenu-Next currently does not support soft-resetting to the game menu. If this is important to you, consider using the nds-bootstrap loader within AKMenu-Next.

Warning

Using the wrong version of Pico-Loader could damage your flashcard! If you are unsure which version to use, check the Supported Platforms section.

  1. Download the latest release of Pico-Loader. Choose the version that corresponds with your flashcart. If you are unsure click here to see a table where you can match up your flashcart with the corresponding loader. If your flashcart is not on the list, you may skip to "nds-bootstrap installation (Optional)" below.

  2. Extract the downloaded Pico_Loader_YOUR_FLASHCART_HERE.zip file with 7-Zip.

  3. Copy the contents of the files from the extracted Pico_Loader_YOUR_FLASHCART_HERE.zip file to the _pico folder on your SD card. Create this folder if it does not exist.

You can now load BOOT.NDS with your flashcart's kernel, or alternatively follow the autoboot steps below.

nds-bootstrap installation (Optional)

  1. Download the latest release of nds-bootstrap.

  2. Extract the downloaded nds-bootstrap.zip file with 7-Zip.

  3. Copy the contents of the files from the extracted nds-bootstrap.zip file to the _nds folder on your SD card.

  4. n AKMenu-Next, press Start and go to Settings. Go to the Other Settings tab and change the Game Loader to nds-bootstrap.

docs.title: Autobooting AKMenu-Next
docs.text:
Note

If you don't see your flashcart in the Autoboot folder or the corresponding one in the README.TXT file, skip this section as you will need to use your flashcart kernel to load AKMenu-Next instead. In some cases you can make a copy of BOOT.NDS and rename it to default.nds to make it chainload autoboot on some flashcart kernels.

  1. Open the Autoboot folder within the AKMenu-Next files. Find the folder that corresponds to your flashcart name or type.

  2. Copy the contents of the folder (do not copy the folder itself) that corresponds with your flashcart to the root of your SD card.

  3. If your flashcart is a DSTTi clone that requires additional boot files, check the Supplementary DSTTi Clone Files folder. You can check the YSMenu compatibility list to check which one you need. If the file you need is not there, you can make copies of the TTMenu.dat file from the DSTT & DSTTi folder and rename them accordingly.

docs.title: Installing AKMenu-Next Nintendo DSi Edition
docs.text:
1. Download the latest release of AKMenu-Next DSi Edition.

  2. Extract the downloaded akmenu-next-dsi.zip file with 7-Zip.

    Warning

    If you are using TWiLight Menu++ and want to dual boot AKMenu-Next, do not copy over BOOT.NDS as this will overwrite the one TWiLight Menu++ uses. You can instead launch akmenu-next.dsi with TWiLight Menu++ or Unlaunch.

  3. From within the AKMenu-Next files, copy the following files/folders to your SD card root:

    • _nds folder
    • BOOT.NDS (Please read the warning above)
    • akmenu-next.dsi
    • title folder (if using HiyaCFW)

  4. Download the latest release of nds-bootstrap.

  5. Extract the downloaded nds-bootstrap.zip file with 7-Zip.

  6. Copy the contents of the files from the extracted nds-bootstrap.zip file to the _nds folder on your SD card.

  7. Load BOOT.NDS with your desired entrypoint method (e.g. Memory Pit, stylehax or Flipnote Lenny). Alternatively, use Unlaunch or TWiLight Menu++ to boot akmenu-next.dsi. If you are using HiyaCFW, it will appear as an app on your home screen, provding that you copied the title folder.

docs.title: Autobooting AKMenu-Next
docs.text:
Note

Autobooting AKMenu-Next on a DSi requires Unlaunch or Astronaut to be installed.

Unlaunch UsersAstronaut Users

  1. Turn on your DSi while holding A and B

  2. In the Unlaunch menu, go to OPTIONS

  3. Set NO BUTTON or a button of your choice to the akmenu-next entry that says akmenu-next.dsi on the bottom screen

  4. Switch off your DSi and switch it back on, it will now automatically boot into AKMenu-Next

  1. Turn on your DSi while holding A and B

  2. In the Astronaut menu, go to Settings, then go to Change Boot Options

  3. Select default boot option and choose Launch something from SD

  4. Locate akmenu-next.dsi on the SD card and select it

  5. Press go back at the bottom and then Save on the previous screen

  6. Switch off your DSi and switch it back on, it will now automatically boot into AKMenu-Next

docs.title: Installing AKMenu-Next Nintendo 3DS Edition
docs.text:
1. Download the latest release of AKMenu-Next 3DS Edition.

  2. Extract the downloaded akmenu-next-3ds.zip file with 7-Zip.

    Warning

    If you are using TWiLight Menu++ on your Nintendo 3DS and want to also use AKMenu-Next, do not copy over BOOT.NDS as this will overwrite the one TWiLight Menu++ uses.

  3. From within the AKMenu-Next files, copy the following files/folders to your SD card root:

    • _nds folder
    • BOOT.NDS (Please read the warning above)
    • akmenu-next.cia

  4. Download the latest release of nds-bootstrap.

  5. Extract the downloaded nds-bootstrap.zip file with 7-Zip.

  6. Copy the contents of the files from the extracted nds-bootstrap.zip file to the _nds folder on your SD card.

  7. Boot up your Nintendo 3DS. Open the FBI app, go to your SD card, and find the akmenu-next.cia file. Select the cia, then choose "Install CIA".

  8. Launch the akmenu-next application from the 3DS home screen.

Tip

If you are upgrading from an older version of AKMenu-Next, or if AKMenu-Next does not appear on your 3DS home screen after installing the cia, restart your 3DS.

docs.title: DSpico with AKMenu-Next (DSpico only)
docs.text:
Console Compatibility

This only works if your DSpico with AKMenu-Next is running on a DSi or 3DS system. It will not load DSiWare on the Original NDS or DS Lite, since those consoles are missing the upgraded DSi hardware for running DSi-mode apps.

  1. Download the DSpico BIOS and NAND dumper utility.

  2. Place pico_file_dump.nds on your DSpico's SD card root.

  3. Create a DSiWare folder on your SD card root, and place any DSiWare ROMs you'd like to play inside.

    DSiWare File Types

    If your DSiWare dump is a file with no file extension, you can change the filename and add .nds to the end to get AKMenu-Next to pick it up.

  4. Eject the SD card, insert it back into your DSpico, then boot into the cart.

  5. In the menu, navigate to and launch pico_file_dump.nds. Dumping will begin.

  6. Once all files have been dumped, press the power button to turn off the system.

  7. Boot up AKMenu-Next and ensure that Game Loader in settings is set to Pico-Loader.

  8. DSiWare and encrypted DS ROMs can now be played! Navigate to the DSiWare folder and launch a game to play.

Optional Filesystem Cleanup

If you don't like the folder clutter caused by copying all the NAND files to the DSpico SD card, you can hide them from the menu by setting the hidden attribute on any files or folders you want hidden.

Windows-only

The following instructions assume Windows is used. Linux/Mac instructions will be added later, but it is possible to hide files and folders on those operating systems as well, with different steps.

  1. Navigate to the SD card root on your PC's file explorer.

  2. While holding the CTRL (Control) key, click on any folders you would like to hide from AKMenu-Next's file list. The following files and folders are recommended to be hidden:

    • _pico folder
    • photo folder
    • shared1 folder
    • shared2 folder
    • sys folder
    • _picoboot.nds
    • boot.nds

  3. After selecting the last file, release the CTRL key, then right click on one of the selected files. In the right click menu, select Properties.

  4. A properties window will open. Under the Attributes section, check the Hidden box, then press OK.

  5. A pop-up window will appear asking to confirm changes. Choose "Apply changes to the selected items, subfolders, and files", then press OK.

  6. The selected files should disappear from the file manager. This is normal. You can view them again by enabling "Show hidden files" in File Explorer's "Folder Options" menu.

  7. Since the BIOS and NAND files have already been dumped, pico_file_dump.nds is no longer necessary and can be deleted from the SD card root.

  8. Insert the SD card back into your DSpico and boot into the menu. The hidden files should no longer show up in the menu list, but DSiWare will still work!

docs.title: AKMenu-Next FAQ
docs.text: Please see below for frequently asked questions about AKMenu-Next.

docs.title: How do I soft-reset or quit back to the menu
docs.text: • Use the nds-bootstrap button combination of L + Down + Select or change it in Settings -> Menu Hotkey.​ More controls can be found on the nds-bootstrap controls page. Pico-Loader currently does not support soft-reset.​

docs.title: What flashcarts does this work with?
docs.text: • This should work on any flashcart that can load homebrew, either via it's kernel, or via one of the provided autoboot files. If not autobooting, some flashcarts such as the Games N Music or some Slot 2 carts booted into NDS mode may require you to DLDI patch BOOT.NDS first.​ ​

docs.title: Can I run DSiWare on AKMenu-Next?
docs.text:
• DSiWare is supported on the DSpico cart when running on a DSi or 3DS with the Game Loader set to Pico-Loader. You must have the required DSi files for this to run, the instructions for this are available above in the main links.​

  • Due to the complexity of adding TWiLight Menu++'s DSiWare implementation for it into the existing akmenu4 code. Please use TWiLight Menu++ to run DSiWare if you are not on a DSpico.​ ​

docs.title: Can I use this alongside TWiLight Menu++ on a DSi or 3DS?
docs.text:
• On a 3DS or a DSi system you must take care to not overwrite the existing BOOT.NDS file required by TWiLight Menu++.​ If you plan to use both on a DSi, copy only the akmenu-next.dsi file and launch that via Unlaunch or TWiLight Menu++. This is explained in the guide. On a 3DS, omit copying the BOOT.NDS file.​ ​
  • Likewise the same applies to a flashcart should you wish to use both, where you should rename the included BOOT.NDS to something else and launch it with the existing kernel you are using.​ ​

docs.title: How can I use a nightly build of nds-bootstrap on AKMenu-Next?
docs.text: • Put a copy of nds-bootstrap-nightly.nds inside the _nds folder. Then go into the settings and under the File system settings section, set nds-bootstrap version to nightly.​ ​

docs.title: What games are compatible?
docs.text:
• Typically most retail games should compatible in the latest version of nds-bootstrap and Pico-Loader. Compatibility with rom-hacks, translations and randomizers are not guaranteed.​ ​

  • Any issues with game compatibility should be submitted on the nds-bootstrap issue tracker or the Pico-Loader issue tracker.

  • Homebrew is supported as well, although homebrew compatibility may be limited on DSi and 3DS systems due to some homebrew only running correctly on flashcarts, on those systems you may opt to use the "nds-bootstrap" option in the "Homebrew Loader" for any homebrew that doesn't load with the default loader.​

docs.title: I have a question not listed here
docs.text: • Please submit your question to the AKMenu-Next GBATemp Thread or if you wish to report a bug, issue or feature request, please open a request on the AKMenu-Next Issue Tracker.

docs.title: AKMenu-Next Plugins
docs.text:
Plugins allow AKMenu-Next to be extended to launch other filetypes including Emulator ROMs and Videos.

Installing PluginsMaking Plugins

  1. Visit the AKMenu-Next Plugins Page and download the plugin you want.

  2. Extract the contents of the plugin download to your computer.

  3. Ensure that the plugin download contains an _nds folder. Copy the _nds folder and any other folders or files next to it and paste it to the root of your SD card. You may be asked to replace files. If you are on Windows, click Replace the file in the destination. If you are on MacOS, click Merge and not Replace otherwise the existing _nds folder will be deleted.

  4. Files that have an extension supported in the plugin will now show in the AKMenu-Next file browser and can be launched

docs.title: Plugin INI
docs.text:
• AKMenu-Next plugins come as {Extension}.ini files which must be loacated in _nds/akmenunext/plugins and use the below format:
[plugin]
path=path/to/nds/here.nds
argv=1
bootstrap=0
  • path = Path to the .nds file that will be launched with the plugin. This file can be located anywhere but the advised location is _nds/akmenunext/plugins/app.
  • argv = Sets whether the filepath of the file launched is passed to the NDS file specified.
  • bootstrap = Sets whether the path of the plugin is launched with nds-bootstap-hb.nds. This is used for the DSi SD card and is ignored if the user is on a flashcart.

docs.title: Icons
docs.text: • Icons are located in _nds/akmenunext/plugins/icons and are standard Nintendo DS banner files. They should be named as {Extension}.bin so that they are loaded when the accompanying extension is loaded. If the icon is missed or invalid, AKMenu-Next will fallback to the default placeholder icon for that extension.

docs.title: AKMenu-Next Themes
docs.text: AKMenu-Next is compatible with Wood R4 and AKAIO themes (also known as AKMenu themes as all three menus are based upon AKMenu). To install themes, please see the below steps:

docs.title: Install AKMenu-Next Themes
docs.text:
1. Visit the Wood R4/AKMenu Theme Repository.
  2. Find a theme you wish to install and download it.
  3. Open/Extract the .7z archive. You can use 7-Zip to do this.
  4. Inside the 7z archive, you will find a folder with the theme's name. Copy this folder to _nds/akmenunext/ui folder on your SD Card.
  5. Place the SD card back into your flashcart or console, and boot into AKMenu-Next.
  6. Press the START key to open the AKMenu-Next start menu popup, then select Settings.
  7. Set the theme to the name of the theme you downloaded, then press A to save, and A again to restart.

Warning

Please ensure that your theme is not a folder inside a folder!

For example if your theme is called "HatsuneMiku", ensure that the path is _nds/akmenunext/ui/HatsuneMiku and not _nds/akmenunext/ui/HatsuneMiku/HatsuneMiku

If you do not check for this, you will end up with a broken AKMenu-Next installation after selecting the theme and will need to reinstall AKMenu-Next, or edit _nds/akmenunext/globasettings.ini to set back one of the default themes (such as "zelda").

docs.title: AKMenu-Next Troubleshooting
docs.text: If you encounter issues when using AKMenu-Next, please refer to the below information:

docs.title: The menu loads with just a black screen and a cursor
docs.text: • You have an incompatible or improperly installed theme, or the _nds folder is missing. Try reinstalling the theme (you may need to edit the name of the theme to the correct folder name in _nds/akmenunext/globalsettings.ini) or reinstalling AKMenu-Next from the Installing AKMenu-Next page.

docs.title: The menu loads but the bottom screen has no icons or text
docs.text: • An error occured trying to read from the SD card. This can sometimes occur by using the wrong version of AKMenu-Next (such as using the DSi version on the DSpico). Please ensure the SD card is fully working and that you have the correct version of AKMenu-Next installed.

docs.title: I get "Loader not found" when trying to run games
docs.text: • You don't have the files for the chosen loader installed, please switch to another loader in the settings, or install the corresponding loader's files. The guides for both compatible loaders (nds-bootstrap and Pico-Loader) are listed on the Installing AKMenu-Next page.

docs.title: I get a message telling me to reinstall AKMenu-Next
docs.text: • Your installation of AKMenu-Next is corrupted or important configuration files are missing. This can sometimes be caused by a failing SD card as well. Please test your SD card with H2TestW or F3 and reinstall AKMenu-Next from the Installing AKMenu-Next page.

docs.title: I get a message telling me there is not enough space available when launching a game
docs.text: • This occurs when there is not enough space available on the SD card to create a save file, or when the SD card unexpectedly becomes inaccessible. Please ensure you have at least 50MB free on your SD card when running games to account for the game's save file and any additional files created by nds-bootstrap or Pico-Launcher. If you have enough free space and are still seeing this error, there may be a problem with your SD card.

docs.title: I get "An error occured", "Data abort" or "Failed to load arm9" or similar errors
docs.text:
• These errors come from the game loader you are using and you should seek assistance for the loader you are using:
  • nds-bootstrap issue tracker
  • Pico-Loader issue tracker
